rawFindings.title: Incorrect usage of semicolon detection logic in 'report' function
rawFindings.explanation: The regular expression OPT_OUT_PATTERN was changed from /^[-[(\/+]$/ to /[\[\(/\+\-]/, widening the match incorrectly and potentially misdetecting tokens that should be opt-out for semicolon removal logic. The previous version was intended to match exact tokens `-`, `[`, `(`, `/`, `+` only, but the new regex matches any token containing any of those characters anywhere, possibly leading to false positives.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original regular expression /^[-[(\/+]$/ for OPT_OUT_PATTERN to accurately match the intended single-character tokens only.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Input like a line ending with ';' followed by a token with value containing one of those characters (e.g., a '+' in '++', or '-' in '--') might lead to incorrect identification of unnecessary semicolons and thus wrong linting behavior, flagging missing semicolons or extra semicolons erroneously.
